cs: Cs is a soft silver-white ductile metallic element.
Cs means the same as cesium or caesium or atomic number 55.
cs gas: CS gas is a tear gas that is stronger than CN gas but wears off faster.
CS gas means the same as chlorobenzylidenemalononitrile.
cse: CSE is Canadian agency that gathers communications intelligence and assist law enforcement and security agencies.
CSE means the same as Communications Security Establishment.
csis: CSIS is Canada's main foreign intelligence agency that gathers and analyzes information to provide security intelligence for the Canadian government.
CSIS means the same as Canadian Security Intelligence Service.
cst: CST is standard time in the 6th time zone west of Greenwich, reckoned at the 90th meridian.
CST means the same as Central Time or Central Standard Time.
